mapper.select: SELECT mn.menu_id, mn.tenant_id, mn.module_id, m.module_nm, mn.parent_menu_id, NULL AS parent_menu_nm, mn.menu_code, mn.menu_nm, mn.menu_dc, mn.menu_url, mn.icon_nm, mn.sort_order, mn.use_at, mn.created_at, mn.updated_at, ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_menu c WHERE c.parent_menu_id = mn.menu_id AND c.use_at = 'Y' ) ) AS has_children FROM tb_menu mn JOIN tb_module m ON m.module_id = mn.module_id WHERE mn.tenant_id = #{value} AND mn.use_at = 'Y' ORDER BY mn.module_id ASC, mn.sort_order ASC, mn.menu_id ASC

SELECT mn.menu_id, mn.tenant_id, mn.module_id, m.module_nm, mn.parent_menu_id, pmn.menu_nm AS parent_menu_nm, mn.menu_code, mn.menu_nm, mn.menu_dc, mn.menu_url, mn.icon_nm, mn.sort_order, mn.use_at, mn.created_at, mn.updated_at, ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_menu c WHERE c.parent_menu_id = mn.menu_id ) ) AS has_children FROM tb_menu mn JOIN tb_module m ON m.module_id = mn.module_id LEFT JOIN tb_menu pmn ON pmn.menu_id = mn.parent_menu_id WHERE mn.menu_id = #{menuId} AND mn.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

INSERT INTO tb_menu ( tenant_id, module_id, parent_menu_id, menu_code, menu_nm, menu_dc, menu_url, icon_nm, sort_order, use_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{moduleId}, #{parentMenuId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{menuCode}, #{menuNm}, #{menuDc}, #{menuUrl}, #{iconNm}, #{sortOrder}, #{useAt} ) RETURNING menu_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_menu SET parent_menu_id = #{parentMenuId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, menu_nm = #{menuNm}, menu_dc = #{menuDc}, menu_url = #{menuUrl}, icon_nm = #{iconNm}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, use_at = #{useAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.permission_code FROM tb_menu_permission mp JOIN tb_permission p ON p.permission_id = mp.permission_id WHERE mp.menu_id = #{value} AND p.use_at = 'Y' ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC, p.permission_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT lar.role_id FROM tb_login_account_role lar JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.login_id = lar.login_id JOIN employees e ON e.id = la.login_code WHERE la.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.id = #{loginCode} ORDER BY lar.role_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT r.role_code FROM tb_login_account_role lar JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.login_id = lar.login_id JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = lar.role_id JOIN employees e ON e.id = la.login_code WHERE la.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.id = #{loginCode} AND COALESCE(r.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY r.role_code ASC
